name: Hamburger Pie
description: A savory pie made with ground beef, green beans, and tomato soup, topped with a layer of mashed potatoes and baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat 4 Tbsp oil in a pan and brown the sliced onion.
Add the hamburger, salt, and pepper to the pan and brown the meat.
Add the cooked green beans and tomato soup to the meat mixture and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with warm milk and beaten egg.
Spoon the mashed potatoes in mounds over the top of the meat mixture in the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

_similar.name: Beef and Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, sautéed celery and onion, and cooked rice, all baked in a tomato soup sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté celery and onion in butter until soft and tender.
Place rice in a greased 1½ quart casserole dish.
Top the rice with the celery mixture.
Season the ground beef with salt and pepper, then cook in a skillet until browned.
Arrange the cooked beef on top of the celery mixture.
Combine the tomato soup with water and pour over the meat layer.
Bake in a preheated 325°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, rice casserole, comfort food

_similar.name: Chicken and Cheese Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting chicken and rice casserole topped with a crunchy corn flake and celery mixture.
recipeIngredient: 1 can Campbell's cream of celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Blend together the chicken, rice, cream soup, milk, cheese, and onion in a large bowl.
Put the mixture into a buttered casserole dish.
Stir the corn flake crumbs into melted butter, then mix in the chopped celery.
Cook until the celery is hot.
Spread the corn flake and celery mixture over the chicken mixture.
Bake in a 375°F oven for about ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: chicken casserole, cheesy rice bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Rosemary Shipwreck Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, potatoes, and a tomato-based sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
In a large bowl, combine beef, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Place potatoes in the bottom of a greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Top potatoes with chopped onion.
Cover onion layer with the beef mixture.
Spoon pork and beans over the beef layer.
Pour tomato soup over the pork and beans.
Cover the casserole and bake for 1 hour or until done.

_similar.keywords: shipwreck casserole, ground beef, potato casserole

_similar.name: Macaroni Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting macaroni and meat casserole topped with cheese and baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1 to 2 cups grated cheese (e.g., cheddar, mozzarella, Monterey Jack)

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the macaroni, drain and set aside.
Brown hamburger, adding onions, green pepper and mushrooms.
Add the spices, ketchup and tomatoes. Reduce heat and simmer.
Place the macaroni and meat mixture in a large casserole dish and mix.
Spoon the mushroom soup across the top, covering the casserole.
Sprinkle the cheese on top.
Cover and bake in 350°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: macaroni casserole, cheesy pasta bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Chinese Hamburger Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty, savory casserole featuring ground hamburger, rice, and vegetables, with an optional addition of bean sprouts for an authentic touch.

recipeInstructions.text: Thoroughly brown hamburger in a skillet; add the onions, celery, cream of mushroom and cream of chicken soups.
Stir in the mushrooms, warm water, uncooked rice, soya sauce, pepper and salt.
Add bean sprouts if using for a more authentic taste.
Turn the ingredients into a casserole dish and bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.
Remove cover, stir the casserole and continue baking for about 15 minutes longer.
Sprinkle chow mein noodles over casserole and bake for 15 minutes more (total baking time is 1 hour).

_similar.keywords: Chinese casserole, hamburger casserole, rice casserole
